blocks.x: BI & Analytics Platform's architecture: the planes, the controls and the evidence export — documented the way your auditors will read it.
Structurally BI & Analytics Platform is planes, not layers — workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.
For BI & Analytics Platform architecture, the build decomposes into named pieces, each with an owner and a gate:
In BI & Analytics Platform, the program tracks these without being asked:

Runtime dependencies: OPC UA, MQTT Sparkplug B, LoRaWAN/NB-IoT, KubeEdge/K3s, CMMS/MES adapters. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for BI & Analytics Platform follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
The next step is small and real: one working session on BI & Analytics Platform architecture, your data, and a written feasibility read you can circulate.
